k:掲.mnemonic: A finger (指) pins a notice above the cradle (勹): 'Quiet, baby sleeping.' The paper hangs up high where every visitor can read it. Put up (hoist, display, hang out).

k:浅.mnemonic: A soldier tests the water left by the tsunami (氵) with his halberd (戈). The shaft goes in only a hand's width before it hits the bottom. Shallow (superficial, frivolous).
k:浅.hint: Halberd barely dips into the water.

k:執.mnemonic: He found happiness (幸) in a round (丸) ball of soil (土), a clod from his own land. He grips it and will not let go, whatever anyone offers. Tenacious (take hold, grasp, take to heart).
k:執.hint: Gripping a clod of his own land.

k:塚.mnemonic: A pig (豕) roots in the soil (土) and heaps it up until the pile stands higher than its own forehead (冖): a small rounded bump in the field. Hillock (mound).
k:塚.hint: Pig heaps earth above its head.

k:胸.mnemonic: For the first month (月) of life a baby's cradle (勹) is the hollow pit (凵) between its mother's arms, held close against the front of her body. Bosom (breast, chest, heart).
k:胸.hint: Baby held in the hollow of arms.

k:盗.mnemonic: You look away, and the food is gone from your dish (皿). The diner in the next (次) seat has an innocent look and a very full mouth. Steal (rob, pilfer).

k:遣.mnemonic: A messenger is sent down the path (辶) with a sealed parcel bound for the far side of Asia (亜), told to leave at once and not stop. Dispatch (send, give, donate).
k:遣.hint: Messenger sent off across a continent.

k:包.mnemonic: A cobra (已) coiled inside a cradle (勹), with the blanket folded right over it so that nothing shows. Better check what is in the bundle. Wrap (pack, cover, conceal).
k:包.hint: Snake bundled up in a blanket.

k:抱.mnemonic: Arms wrap (包) around someone and the fingers (扌) lock together behind their back, holding them close. Embrace (hug, hold in arms).

k:遅.mnemonic: A sheep (羊) leads the parade down the path (辶) carrying the flag (尸), and stops to nibble every tuft of grass. Everyone behind it arrives late. Slow (late, back, behind).
k:遅.hint: Parade led by a nibbling sheep.

k:俳.mnemonic: A leader (亻) answers an injustice (非) not with a speech but with three short lines about a frog and a pond, and the whole court falls silent. Haiku (actor).
k:俳.hint: Three short lines about a frog.

k:湖.mnemonic: Water from a tsunami (氵) that never drained away. A month (月) later it is still there, and by the time it is old (古) it has reeds, herons and rowing boats. Lake.
k:湖.hint: Flood water that stayed for good.

k:操.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) work the ropes of a crane built in a tree (木), swinging three crates of goods (品) through the branches and setting them down exactly on the mark. Maneuver (manipulate, operate, steer).

k:荷.mnemonic: 'What (何) is in all those bags?' asks the porter. Flowers (艹), it turns out: a whole garden packed in trunks and piled on his shoulders. Baggage (load, bear a burden).
k:荷.hint: Porter with trunks full of blooms.

k:奏.mnemonic: At harvest a person (人) stands among the grain (禾) and lifts a flute toward heaven (天), thanking the sky with a tune. Play music (speak to a ruler, complete).
k:奏.hint: Flute raised to the sky at harvest.

k:益.mnemonic: One (一) dish (皿) served with both horns (丷) and fins (ハ): meat and fish for the price of a single plate. The diner gets more than he paid for. Benefit (gain, profit, advantage).
k:益.hint: Meat and fish on one plate.

k:飯.mnemonic: A child who is anti- (反) everything on the table is told to eat (食) his rice anyway. The bowl is turned back toward him three times a day. Meal (boiled rice).
k:飯.hint: Rice bowl pushed back to a fussy child.

k:浮.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) sweeps in, and a claw (爪) of a hand grips the child (子) from above, holding him at the surface so that he bobs on top of the water. Floating (float, rise to surface).
k:浮.hint: Child held bobbing on the water.

k:潟.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) pours over the sandbar into a basin shaped like a mortar (臼) and rests there, calm as a cradle (勹), its surface flickering like flames (灬) at sunset. Lagoon.
k:潟.hint: Sea water resting behind a sandbar.

k:層.mnemonic: Dig down through the rice field (田), and each day (日) of digging uncovers another band of earth. You mark every band with a little flag (尸). Stratum (social class, layer, story).
k:層.hint: Flagged bands of earth in a pit.

k:秘.mnemonic: The farmer invariably (必) hides one sack of grain (禾) under the floorboards, and invariably tells no one where it is. Secret (conceal).
k:秘.hint: Sack of grain under the floorboards.

k:刺.mnemonic: You dry your hands on a towel (巾) hung on a tree (木), and something like a tiny knife (刂) goes into your thumb. The tree was a rose. Thorn (pierce, stab, prick).
k:刺.hint: Tiny blade hidden in the rose tree.

k:盤.mnemonic: A carrier (般) balances a wide flat dish (皿) on one hand and glides between the tables with all the cups riding on it. Tray (shallow bowl, platter, board).
k:盤.hint: Waiter gliding with cups on one hand.

k:湯.mnemonic: At dawn (旦) the bathhouse opens: a tsunami (氵) pours into the tub and streamers (勿) of steam curl up from the surface into the cold air. Hot water (bath, hot spring).
k:湯.hint: Steam curling off the morning tub.

k:仙.mnemonic: A leader (亻) who walked away from everyone to live alone on a mountain (山), growing a long white beard among the clouds. Hermit (wizard, cent).
k:仙.hint: Bearded loner up in the clouds.

k:往.mnemonic: The master (主) sets out on a stroll (彳) that turns into months on the road, lamp in hand, following wherever it leads. Journey (travel, going, let go).

k:郵.mnemonic: Ten thousand (万) letters arrive at the borough (阝) office every morning, to be sorted into sacks and carried to every door. Mail (stagecoach stop).
k:郵.hint: Sacks of letters at the borough office.

k:荒.mnemonic: The river (川) burst its banks. The flowers (艹) are flattened, the crops are deceased (亡), and nothing but mud is left across the valley. Laid waste (rough, rude, wild).

k:緒.mnemonic: Someone (者) twists thread (糸) into a stout cord and knots it on as the strap of a sandal. That first knot is the start of the whole shoe. Thong (beginning, end, cord).
k:緒.hint: Cord knotted as a sandal strap.

k:欧.mnemonic: A continent cut into ward (区) after little ward, each with its own flag and language. What they lack (欠) in size they make up in number. Europe.
k:欧.hint: Many small countries on one map.
